# Entity Digital Sports

> > Entity Digital Sports provides comprehensive sports data APIs and real-time feeds for Cricket, Football, Basketball, Baseball, Hockey, NFL, Tennis, and Kabaddi with fantasy sports integration.

Entity Digital Sports specializes in transforming raw sports data into actionable business insights through robust API solutions. The platform serves fantasy sports platforms, sports websites, and analytics applications with real-time scores, player statistics, match data, and customizable widgets across multiple sports leagues worldwide.

## Key Topics

- Cricket API
- Football API
- Basketball API
- Baseball API (MLB)
- NFL API
- Hockey API
- Tennis API
- Kabaddi API
- Real-time sports data
- Fantasy sports data
- Live scores and updates
- Sports data widgets
- API integration
- Sports analytics
- Data validation and quality

## Core Products & Services

- [Sports Data Widgets](https://www.entitysport.com/sports-data-widgets): Sports data widgets for Cricket, Football, Basketball with real-time data
- [Baseball API | MLB API | Baseball Data Feed | Fantasy Data API](https://www.entitysport.com/baseball-api): MLB Baseball API with live scores, CPBL coverage, and fantasy data feeds
